response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.track_count, c.track_count / a.avg_count AS ratio FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_c a ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
